title: Evaluation of Efficacy and Safety of Intradiscal Gelified Ethanol in Refractory Cervical Discogenic Pain
official: Intradiscal Gelified Ethanol in Refractory Cervical Discogenic Pain : a Interventional, Prospective, Multi-center, Open-label Study.
summary: The purpose of this study is to assesse safety and efficacy of the Intradiscal Gelified Ethanol for treatment in refractory cervical discogenic pain.
